**Summary:**

I resolved ticket T-6005 by analyzing the clickstream-ingest pod logs and identifying that the Kafka broker is applying producer-side throttling to the clickstream-ingest API key. The broker throttle warnings (2.7-3.0 seconds), 96% full producer queue, and growing consumer lag despite low CPU usage all point to a broker-side quota limit rather than a Kubernetes resource problem. The fix is for the team to contact the data platform team to increase the producer rate quota for their API key.
